issues.text: The status of REQ-110. The header of docs/requirements.yaml says only «Статус done ставит только DOC-UPDATER после PASS от RELEASE-VALIDATOR»; it has no rule that a new unmet criterion reopens a done block, and the role file says REQ-ANALYST moves no status. So the status stays `done`, and the amendment note says plainly that criteria 12-19 are not met. Recommended (a): ORCH sets `in_progress` when the fix starts (step 03 CODE-DESIGNER of ISS-0132-20261123-01), DOC-UPDATER sets `done` after the RELEASE-VALIDATOR PASS. (b) leave `done` until the release — the file then says done while 8 criteria are unmet; (c) a new requirement instead of the amendment — the diagnosis and the task chose REQ-110, which already lists every entry point with its exit code.

The e2e runner (script `e2e`, tools/test/e2e/run.js) is in neither list of the diagnosis (I3). It starts Chrome and stands, and its kit stops them by a process group (tools/test/e2e/kit/cleanup.js uses process.kill(-pid), the same silent pass on win32 as the executor), and the owner's rules never run e2e on Windows (decisions/0110). Recommended (a): it refuses on an unsupported platform with NODE_REFUSAL_EXIT, as written in criterion 13. (b) count it as a thin client — its group stops would silently fail; (c) leave it in neither table — then criterion 13 needs a third table.

`--help` on an unsupported platform. Recommended (a): answered as under a supported platform (code 0, the same stdout, nothing written) for pixel-office and pixel-office-note, the same rule as criterion 11 for the floor (decisions/0119 О8), written in criterion 13; the diagnosis (I4) left it to the designer. (b) refused like a start — then criterion 13 changes by one sentence.

The refusal line is Russian only (with the English gloss in tools/README.md), like every refusal of the tools (node-floor.js, team/errors.js, web/texts.js) — the diagnosis I9 noted that a bilingual stderr line would depart from them. Criterion 12 is written so.

The title of REQ-110 names only the Node floor; after this amendment the block also holds the platform guard. The write set allows only the criteria and the status note, so the title is unchanged. Recommended: ORCH decides whether a later micro-amendment widens the title (e.g. «… and the supported platforms Linux and macOS (defect ISS-0132)»); DOC-UPDATER may not do it under decisions/0079 item 5, because it changes what the title promises.

Criterion 17 (the mode read back, PG-7) was «recommended» in the diagnosis; it is taken because the defect's own item 1 asks for it and it is platform-independent (also a FAT or network mount on Linux or macOS); the error code of the state folder is the design's (E_HOME exists for the team home).

Not covered, as the diagnosis says (I2 D): `O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0` in tools/src/handoffs/check.js, tools/src/traces/check.js and the picker stays a residual race on win32 in tools that must keep running on the thin client; an lstat check comes first everywhere. Proposal: a LOW defect, not a criterion here (AP-019). Porting (taskkill /T, ACLs) is out of scope by decisions/0127 Г and 0134 item 4.
The anti-pattern proposal of the diagnosis (I8: a protection that depends on the OS falls back silently to «pass») is DOC-UPDATER's at the end of the run (Q13); nothing written here.
